comoLlegar.title: It's closer than it looks.
comoLlegar.body: Puerto Libertad sits on national route 12, between Puerto Esperanza and Wanda, on the way to Iguazú. You park at the door and never touch the car again.

relato.intro: A walk through La Casa del Lago in photos: from the first reflection on the water to the last thoughtfully chosen corner.

atardecer.c: You paddle until the sun touches the water.

remada.c: You leave the shore and the forest closes in around you.

mirador.c: You walk down to the shore to look at the lake and lose track of time.

mate.c: The first one is early, with the water still glassy.

fogata.c: When it cools down, the fire gets built by the water.

fuego.c: It all starts with the wood lit and the board full.

disco.c: Dinner cooks outside while the sky turns.

lago.c: Some evenings the water goes so still it doubles the sky.

kayak.c: Two paddles, and the house slowly falls behind.

costa.c: The whole grove fits inside the reflection.

spaceBody.aratiri: Wood and brick facing the lake: two bedrooms, a covered deck with a grill and a deck where the day ends watching the sunset over the water. The Aratirí is the roomiest cabin in the house, with a full kitchen, a wood stove for cool nights and direct access to the dock and the pool — perfect for families or two couples who want to disconnect without giving up comfort.

legal.cancelIntro: We know plans change. These are the terms we work with, the same for every unit and every payment method.
legal.cancelH1: Cancelling 7 or more days in advance
legal.cancelP1: We refund 100% of what you paid. The refund goes back through the same method you used and may take up to 10 business days to appear, depending on your bank or card issuer.
legal.cancelP2: No refund applies. Let us know anyway: if we manage to rebook those dates, we'll return whatever we're able to recover.
legal.cancelP3: If you don't arrive and didn't tell us, it counts as a cancellation within 7 days: no refund applies.
legal.cancelP4: With 7 or more days' notice you can move your booking to other dates within the same year, subject to availability and the rate for the new dates. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.
legal.cancelP5: If circumstances beyond our control mean we can't host you, we refund 100% regardless of when it happens, and we'll help you find equivalent lodging nearby.
legal.cancelP6: Message us on WhatsApp with your booking code. The date and time of your message is what counts.
legal.privacyIntro: This notice explains what data we keep about you, what for, and how to ask us to delete it. It applies to La Casa del Lago Urugua-í and to bookings made through this site.
legal.privacyP1: When you book we ask for your first and last name, email and phone number. If you pay by bank transfer, we also store the receipt you upload. If you pay by card, Mercado Pago handles the card details directly: we never see or store them.
legal.privacyP2: Only to manage your booking: confirming it, arranging check-in, issuing your receipt, and contacting you if something comes up during your stay. We don't use it for advertising and we don't send newsletters.
legal.privacyP3: Nobody, apart from the services we need for the booking to work: Mercado Pago (payment processing) and Supabase (database and receipt storage). We don't sell or hand data to third parties.
legal.privacyP4: Booking data is kept as long as we need it to meet our accounting and tax obligations. Transfer receipts are stored in a private space that isn't publicly accessible.
legal.privacyP5: You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete your data by writing to info@lacasadellago.com.ar. We reply within 10 calendar days.
legal.privacyP6: We use Google Analytics to understand how the site is browsed (page views, where visitors come from). This is aggregate data and doesn't identify you personally. You can block it from your browser settings.
legal.privacyP7: For any question about your data: info@lacasadellago.com.ar or WhatsApp.
